metadata.description: Deploys the TenuVault cloud backup runner into your own subscription: an Azure Automation account with a managed identity, the Invoke-TenuVaultBackup runbook, the container scoped backup writer role, and one tenant schedule. Backups are written as plain JSON: Azure encrypts the storage account at rest and your role assignments decide who can read it, so no Key Vault or recovery key is needed. Setups made before runbook 1.2.0 also created a Key Vault (kv-tenuvault-<suffix>) for the recovery key: run New-TenuVaultCloudBackup.ps1 again with the same resource group and Automation account to upgrade one, and delete the vault once no TenuVault setup in this or any other Automation account still has a TenuVaultKeyVault variable. The template cannot grant Microsoft Graph application roles (no ARM resource can): a Global Administrator assigns the five read-only DeviceManagement roles listed in the deployment outputs to the managed identity, or runs New-TenuVaultCloudBackup.ps1 with -GrantGraphRoles instead. The setup script is the fuller path (it also creates the failure alert and computes the first schedule occurrence); this template is the portal friendly bootstrap that produces the same resources.
metadata.author: Ugur Koc

Existing storage account that holds the intune-backups container, the same account the tenant uses in TenuVault. Deploy this template into that storage account's resource group (New-TenuVaultStorage.ps1 uses rg-tenuvault-backups). For a storage account in another resource group, use New-TenuVaultCloudBackup.ps1 instead.

For a storage move, an existing user-assigned managed identity with permission to read the Automation variables and the exact policy blob in both accounts, plus create-only access to that blob in the destination. The deployer must be allowed to attach this identity.
Set true on a first deployment or to initialize a missing omission enrollment variable. Existing enrollment is preserved.
Leave at the generated default so Azure checks enrollment again on each deployment.
Region for the Automation account.
Automation account name. One account serves the one Entra tenant its managed identity belongs to.
What cloud backups cover. policies is everything except apps, the desktop default.
Comma separated type folders to leave out. Wins over the scope. Leave empty for the scope.
The tenant's name as change reports show it. Leave empty to name the tenant by its id.
Change reports by email through the notification watcher: off, names (which settings changed) or full (with their values). Secret values are never included.
Name who made each change in change reports, from the Intune audit log.

Set true only when the tenant decided to grant DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All (it also exposes the device inventory). Otherwise cloud backups leave out DeviceCategories and DeviceCleanupRules.
Schedule frequency.
Day of the week, for a weekly schedule.
First run, as an ISO 8601 date time with offset, at least 5 minutes in the future, for example 2026-11-01T02:00:00+01:00. Its time of day becomes the recurring backup time.
IANA timezone for the schedule, for example Europe/Berlin. Daylight saving follows the timezone.
Where the published runbook is loaded from. Pin a release tag or your own copy if you prefer.

properties.description: TenuVault Backup Writer: writes backups. Cannot delete blobs, blob versions or containers.
TenuVault scheduled Intune backup in Azure

properties.scriptContent:
set -eu
report() {
  jq -n --arg message "$1" --arg binding "$binding" '{message: $message, binding: $binding}' > "$AZ_SCRIPTS_OUTPUT_PATH"
}
# Listing distinguishes a missing variable from a failed lookup and returns the unencrypted string values.
url="https://management.azure.com$AUTOMATION_ID/variables?api-version=2024-10-23"
attempt=0
until page=$(az rest --method get --url "$url" --output json --only-show-errors); do
  attempt=$((attempt + 1))
  if [ "$attempt" -ge 12 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'Cloud backup storage was not changed. Could not read Automation variables. Check the deployment identity permissions.' >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 5
done
entries='[]'
while :; do
  entries=$(jq -ce --argjson entries "$entries" '.value | if type == "array" then $entries + . else error("Invalid Automation variables response") end' <<< "$page")
  next=$(jq -r '.nextLink // empty' <<< "$page")
  if [ -z "$next" ]; then break; fi
  page=$(az rest --method get --url "$next" --output json --only-show-errors)
done
lookup() {
  jq -r --arg name "$1" '.[] | select((.name | ascii_downcase) == ($name | ascii_downcase)) | .properties.value | fromjson | select(type == "string")' <<< "$entries"
}
binding=$(lookup "TenuVaultOmissionAccount-$TENANT_KEY")
previous=$(lookup "TenuVaultStorageAccount-$TENANT_KEY")
if [ -z "$previous" ]; then previous=$(lookup 'TenuVaultStorageAccount'); fi
enrolled=false
if [ -n "$previous" ] && [[ ",$binding," == *",$previous,"* ]]; then enrolled=true; fi
refuse_move() {
  printf '%s\n' "Cloud backup storage was not changed. Omission is enrolled on $previous and an enabled policy could not be verified on $NEW_ACCOUNT. Check the migration identity and both policy blobs before retrying." >&2
  exit 1
}
if [ "$MIGRATE_POLICY" != 'true' ]; then
  if [ "$previous" != "$NEW_ACCOUNT" ] && [ "$enrolled" = true ]; then refuse_move; fi
  report 'No omission policy migration was requested.'
  exit 0
fi
blob=".tenuvault-control/$TENANT_ID/secret-omission.json"
file=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$file"' EXIT
read_policy() {
  az storage blob download --account-name "$1" --auth-mode login --container-name intune-backups --name "$blob" --file "$file" --overwrite --only-show-errors >/dev/null 2>&1 &&
    jq -e --arg tenant "$TENANT_ID" --argjson enrolled "$enrolled" '.version == 1 and .tenantId == $tenant and (.enabled | type == "boolean") and (.scripts | type == "boolean") and (.generation | type == "string") and ((.generation | test("^[a-f0-9-]{36}$")) or (.generation == "default" and (.enabled | not))) and (.enabled or ((.scripts or $enrolled) | not))' "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1
}
report_policy() {
  if jq -e '.enabled' "$file" >/dev/null; then binding=$(printf '%s\n' "$binding" "$NEW_ACCOUNT" | tr ',' '\n' | awk 'NF && !seen[$0]++' | paste -sd, -); fi
  report "$1"
}
if read_policy "$NEW_ACCOUNT"; then
  report_policy "Keeping the omission policy already set on $NEW_ACCOUNT."
elif [ "$previous" = "$NEW_ACCOUNT" ]; then
  report 'Cloud backup storage was unchanged.'
elif [[ "$previous" =~ ^[a-z0-9]{3,24}$ ]] && read_policy "$previous" &&
     az storage blob upload --account-name "$NEW_ACCOUNT" --auth-mode login --container-name intune-backups --name "$blob" --file "$file" --if-none-match '*' --content-type application/json --only-show-errors >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  report_policy "Copied the omission policy to $NEW_ACCOUNT."
elif read_policy "$NEW_ACCOUNT"; then
  report_policy "Keeping the omission policy already set on $NEW_ACCOUNT."
elif [ "$enrolled" = true ]; then
  refuse_move
else
  report 'Verify the omission setting in the destination account before resuming cloud backups.'
fi

metadata.description: Object (principal) id of the Automation account identity. A Global Administrator assigns it the Graph application roles below.

graphRolesToAssign.value: DeviceManagementConfiguration.Read.All, DeviceManagementApps.Read.All, DeviceManagementServiceConfig.Read.All, DeviceManagementScripts.Read.All, DeviceManagementRBAC.Read.All (plus DeviceManagementManagedDevices.Read.All only when includeDeviceCategories is true)

metadata.description: Read-only Microsoft Graph application roles for the managed identity. Until they are assigned every run fails with access denied, on purpose.

pasteIntoTenuVault.value:
[concat('tenantId=', parameters('tenantId'), '
subscriptionId=', subscription().subscriptionId, '
resourceGroup=', resourceGroup().name, '
automationAccount=', parameters('automationAccountName'), '
storageAccount=', parameters('storageAccountName'), '
scheduleName=', variables('scheduleName'), '
frequency=', if(equals(parameters('frequency'), 'Week'), 'weekly', 'daily'), '
time=', substring(parameters('scheduleStartTime'), 11, 5), '
weekDay=', parameters('weekDay'), '
timeZone=', parameters('timeZone'), '
tenantKey=', variables('tenantKey'), '
linked=true')]
